description: Full-text search over every published piece (titles, deks, context lines, outlet names, and source headlines). Returns matching pieces with slug, title, URL, and a highlighted snippet, best matches first. Use the slug with get_audit for full detail.

limit.description: Maximum results to return (default 25, hard cap 100).

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'McConnell hospital photo'. Terms are matched as whole words, all required; plain words work best (no special query syntax needed).

name: search_corpus
